final_engineering_tolerance_note: Prespecified practical tolerances, not a statistical noninferiority proof; report three-seed means/sample SD/paired differences/all failed seeds

speed_gate.rounds: N*ceil(5/N): minimum five rounds and complete cyclic position balance
speed_gate.order: cyclic +1; every model visits each position equally
speed_gate.design_revision: Before source freeze or any model training/profile: replace incomplete five rotations for N>5 with full position balance; thresholds unchanged

compression.old_768: W11 matched E0 is read-only negative reference, no repeat

selection.conditional_parent: At most one accuracy-tolerant decoder among D01,D02,D04-D10 with stable speed not slower at both sizes; choose lowest max paired latency ratio, then higher IoU, then fewer parameters; run exactly hidden960/896 if parent selected
selection.final_candidates: Pareto top2 among fully completed accuracy-tolerant strictly-smaller and >=5% faster stable candidates, ordered worst-size paired latency then IoU then parameters; otherwise retain negative results and stop new module search
selection.three_seed: Same final accuracy tolerances on mean, >=2/3 seeds IoU >=-.002, plus full stable speed gate; no boundary/continuity improvement claim unless actually improved

resources.known_user_service: crack_console/server.py --port8765; identify process creation/exe, not stale PID
